title: Unit 1 第四课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音练习
sections.instruction: 根据题意选出画线部分发音符合要求的选项。

questions.prompt: 1. 画线字母“e”发音为 /e/ 的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线字母e发音为/e/的单词。
questions.explanation: pen中的字母e发短元音 /e/；she, evening, these中的e均发长元音 /iː/。故选C。

questions.prompt: 2. 画线字母“e”发音为 /iː/ 的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线字母e发音为/iː/的单词。
questions.explanation: these中的第一个字母e发长元音 /iː/；well, pencil, help中的e均发短元音 /e/。故选C。

questions.prompt: 3. 画线字母“a”发音为 /æ/ 的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线字母a发音为/æ/的单词。
questions.explanation: hat中的字母a处于闭音节中，发短元音 /æ/；plane, same, late中的a处于相对开音节中，发双元音 /eɪ/。故选C。

questions.prompt: 4. 下列单词中画线字母与 b<u>a</u>nd 中的字母“a”读音相同的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 选出与band中字母a读音相同的单词。
questions.explanation: band中的字母a发短元音 /æ/；black中的a同样发 /æ/；orange中的a发 /ɪ/；what中的a发 /ɒ/；name中的a发 /eɪ/。故选A。

sections.title: 二、用方框内的词填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案填入空白处。

questions.prompt: 1. He watches TV for two ______ every day.
questions.translation: 他每天看两个小时的电视。
questions.explanation: 表示持续一段时间用hour，two大于1，需用复数形式hours。故选A。

questions.translation: 她非常喜爱运动。
questions.explanation: 主语She为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词love需加s变为loves。故选A。

questions.translation:
——你的年龄多大？
——我12岁了。
questions.explanation: 根据答语“I'm 12 years old.”可知询问年龄，age意为“年龄”。故选A。

questions.translation: 不同的人有不同的业余爱好。
questions.explanation: different后接可数名词复数，hobby以辅音字母+y结尾，变复数需改y为i再加es变为hobbies。故选A。

questions.translation: 她既不会读也不会写。
questions.explanation: 情态动词can't后连接并列动词原形read or write。故选A。

questions.prompt: 6. They couldn't give me any more ______.
questions.translation: 他们无法给我提供更多的信息了。
questions.explanation: information（信息）为不可数名词，没有复数形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: 7. The math problem is very easy; ______ a child can work it out.
questions.translation: 这道数学题非常简单，甚至一个小孩都能解出来。
questions.explanation: 副词even表示“甚至，连……都”，起强调递进作用。故选A。

questions.prompt: 8. I usually exercise at ______ ten thirty.
questions.translation: 我通常在十点半左右锻炼。
questions.explanation: 介词about接在具体时刻前表示“大约，左右”。故选A。

sections.title: 三、连词成句
sections.instruction: 将所给词语连成一句话，注意大小写和标点符号。

questions.translation: 我现在住在中国。
questions.explanation: 陈述句：主语“I” + 谓语“live” + 地点状语“in China” + 时间状语“now”，句末用句号。

questions.translation: 篮球是我最喜爱的运动。
questions.explanation: 主系表结构：主语“Basketball” + 系动词“is” + 表语“my favourite sport”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: tennis, he, plays, with, my, every, weekend, brother, my, friends, and, (.)
questions.answer: He plays tennis with my brother and my friends every weekend.
questions.translation: 他每个周末都和我哥哥以及我的朋友们一起打网球。
questions.explanation: 主谓宾句型：主语“He” + 谓语“plays tennis” + 伴随状语“with my brother and my friends” + 时间状语“every weekend”，句末用句号。

questions.translation: 你的业余爱好是什么？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句：疑问代词“What” + 系动词“are” + 主语“your hobbies”，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: a, we, pet, parrot, have, too, (.)
questions.answer: We have a pet parrot, too.
questions.translation: 我们也有一只宠物鹦鹉。
questions.explanation: 主谓宾结构：主语“We” + 谓语“have” + 宾语“a pet parrot” + 句末副词“too”，句末用句号。

sections.title: 四、阅读还原 (五选四)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
We're lucky, because we have a good class monitor. [1] Every day he runs to school. He runs really fast. In class he can answer any question. He can speak Chinese, English and French. [2] He can swim well too. He is strong and can eat three bowls of noodles for lunch. He can eat four apples at a time.

Bob's mother works in a school library. [3] He learns a lot from books. He is kind and gets on well with others in our class. He is always ready to help others. I think Bob can do any job. [4]
wordbank: A. He can also play a lot of sports, like basketball, soccer and ping-pong.
B. He can make our classroom beautiful.
C. So he can read many books in it.
D. For example, he can be a doctor, a singer or a spaceman.
E. His name is Bob. He can do many things.

options: E. His name is Bob. He can do many things.
A. He can also play a lot of sports, like basketball, soccer and ping-pong.
B. He can make our classroom beautiful.
C. So he can read many books in it.
D. For example, he can be a doctor, a singer or a spaceman.
questions.translation: 我们很幸运，因为我们有一个好班长。他的名字叫鲍勃。他能做很多事情。
questions.explanation: 前句提到we have a good class monitor，后文分述其跑步、回答问题等本领，E项“His name is Bob. He can do many things.”引出人物及下文。故选A (E项)。

options: A. He can also play a lot of sports, like basketball, soccer and ping-pong.
E. His name is Bob. He can do many things.
B. He can make our classroom beautiful.
C. So he can read many books in it.
D. For example, he can be a doctor, a singer or a spaceman.
questions.translation: 他还会做很多体育运动，比如篮球、足球和乒乓球。他也游得很好。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着说“He can swim well too.”，说明此句讨论体育运动技能，A项“He can also play a lot of sports...”最契合。故选A (A项)。

options: C. So he can read many books in it.
A. He can also play a lot of sports, like basketball, soccer and ping-pong.
B. He can make our classroom beautiful.
D. For example, he can be a doctor, a singer or a spaceman.
E. His name is Bob. He can do many things.
questions.translation: 鲍勃的母亲在学校图书馆工作。所以他可以在里面读很多书。
questions.explanation: 前句提到母亲在图书馆工作，C项“So he can read many books in it.”（因果连贯，in it代指图书馆）承上启下。故选A (C项)。

options: D. For example, he can be a doctor, a singer or a spaceman.
B. He can make our classroom beautiful.
C. So he can read many books in it.
A. He can also play a lot of sports, like basketball, soccer and ping-pong.
E. His name is Bob. He can do many things.
questions.translation: 我认为鲍勃能胜任任何工作。例如，他可以当医生、歌手或宇航员。
questions.explanation: 前句提到“I think Bob can do any job.”，D项“For example, he can be a doctor, a singer or a spaceman.”举例说明具体职业，衔接顺畅。故选A (D项)。

sections.title: 五、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
The new term begins. Damao meets some new friends at school. "My name is Damao. Nice to meet you in China," he says to these friends. "Nice to meet you, Damao," says an English boy. "I'm Tony Brown. Tony is my first name and my last name is Brown. Is Da your last name?"

"No," Damao smiles. "Da isn't my last name and Mao isn't, either."

"Really?" asks Lisa Green, an American girl. "Then what's your last name?"

"Han, and my full name is Han Damao," Damao says.

"It's fun," Tony and Lisa say.

Then they talk about their teacher. "Who is in our classroom?" Damao asks.

"Helen Keller," Tony says. "She is our English teacher from America."

"Can I call her Miss Helen?" Damao asks.

"No, please call her Miss Keller. Helen is her first name," Tony says.

"Oh, I see. Thank you, Tony," Damao says. Then Damao and his friends go into the classroom happily.

questions.prompt: 1. Where does Damao meet his new friends?
questions.translation: 大毛在哪里遇到他的新朋友的？
questions.explanation: 根据大毛说的“Nice to meet you in China”以及后文进入教室可知，是在中国的学校里。故选A。

questions.translation: 大毛的姓氏是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据大毛说的“Han, and my full name is Han Damao”可知，大毛姓韩（Han）。故选A。

questions.translation: 谁是英语老师？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“Helen Keller ... She is our English teacher from America.”可知，海伦（Helen）是英语老师。故选A。

options: The teacher is in the classroom now.
Lisa and Tony are from the same country.
questions.translation: 哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据文中问句“Who is in our classroom?”及回答“Helen Keller ... She is our English teacher”可知老师现在在教室里。故选A。

questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲了什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述新学期开始，大毛在学校结识新朋友并讨论中英文名字及老师的开学第一天经历。故选A。

sections.title: 六、语篇填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案填入空白处。
sections.passage: Hello! I'm Anna. Look at this photo. The woman in [1] orange dress is my mother. She teaches [2] in a middle school. My mother [3] up at 6:30. It takes her about 40 minutes to go to school [4] bus. She has two [5] in the morning. We [6] have lunch at a restaurant near school. At 14:00, she has an English class. She is kind to [7] students, [8] they like her a lot. At 17:40, she comes back home. She cooks dinner at 17:50. At 18:30, we have dinner. After dinner, she [9] a book. Sometimes, she helps [10] with my homework. I think she is a very good mother. I love her a lot.

questions.translation: 穿一条橙色连衣裙的女士是我妈妈。
questions.explanation: orange以元音音素开头，表示“一条橙色连衣裙”用不定冠词an。故选A。

questions.translation: 她在中学教英语。
questions.explanation: 动词teaches后接学科名称，应用English（英语）。故选A。

questions.translation: 我妈妈6:30起床。
questions.explanation: 主语My mother为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词get需加s变为gets。故选A。

questions.translation: 乘公共汽车去学校。
questions.explanation: by bus为固定介词短语，意为“乘公共汽车”。故选A。

questions.translation: 她在上午有两节课。
questions.explanation: 基数词two后接可数名词复数classes。故选A。

questions.translation: 我们通常在学校附近的餐馆吃午餐。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词短语have lunch应用频度副词usually。故选A。

questions.translation: 她对她的学生很亲切友好。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词students应用形容词性物主代词her。故选A。

questions.translation: 所以他们非常喜欢她。
questions.explanation: 前面是原因（对学生亲切），后面是结果（学生喜欢她），用表示结果的连词so。故选A。

questions.translation: 晚饭后，她看一本书。
questions.explanation: 主语she为第三人称单数，谓语动词read加s变为reads。故选A。

questions.translation: 有时候，她辅导我的家庭作业。
questions.explanation: help sb. with sth. 为固定搭配，动词helps后接宾格代词me。故选A。

sections.title: 七、阅读匹配 (段落标题配对)
sections.instruction: 阅读下面文字，从 A 到 F 选项中为每个段落选取一个最适合的标题。
sections.passage:
As the most important and oldest festival in China, the Spring Festival is connected with many traditions and customs.

[1] When Chinese people meet during the Spring Festival, they don't kiss or hug like Westerners. The first thing for the Chinese New Year visit is to kneel down (叩首) or bow to the elders to show their respect.

[2] It is said that the dangerous monster Nian would come to harm people and animals on the eve. In order to avoid that, people will shut the doors and stay awake.

[3] On the first day of the festival, people are not allowed to throw away rubbish or clean the rooms. They believe all the good luck will be driven away, if they do that.

[4] As the Chinese New Year arrives, every family puts up its New Year paintings in order to say goodbye to the past and welcome the future.

[5] On the early morning of Chinese New Year's Day, people set off fireworks. They wish to welcome the good luck inside when they open up their doors in the morning.
wordbank: A. Colorful pictures on the walls
D. Staying up on New Year's Eve
F. No sweeping on New Year's Day

questions.translation: 第一段：向长辈拜年
questions.explanation: 第一段讲述过年拜年时向长辈鞠躬叩首以示尊敬，对应C项“Greeting the family elders”（向长辈问候致敬）。

questions.answer: D. Staying up on New Year's Eve
questions.translation: 第二段：除夕守岁
questions.explanation: 第二段讲述除夕夜为防年兽侵扰而关门守夜，对应D项“Staying up on New Year's Eve”（除夕守岁）。

questions.answer: F. No sweeping on New Year's Day
questions.translation: 第三段：大年初一不扫地
questions.explanation: 第三段讲述大年初一不扔垃圾、不打扫房间以留住好运，对应F项“No sweeping on New Year's Day”（大年初一不打扫）。

questions.answer: A. Colorful pictures on the walls
questions.translation: 第四段：张贴年画
questions.explanation: 第四段讲述家家户户张贴年画辞旧迎新，对应A项“Colorful pictures on the walls”（墙上色彩斑斓的图画/年画）。

questions.translation: 第五段：开门放炮竹
questions.explanation: 第五段讲述大年初一清晨开门放鞭炮迎接好运，对应B项“The opening-door fireworks”（开门鞭炮）。
